Visit with Dr. Sam Lee on Oct 1, 2026 (Neurology)
Reason for visit: memory concerns

Your doctor reviewed your memory test results with you and your
son. Results were similar to last year.

Start donepezil 5 mg at bedtime. After 4 weeks increase to 10 mg at bedtime if no stomach upset.
Continue vitamin B12 1000 mcg daily.
Get an MRI of the brain; the imaging center will call to schedule.
Pick up the new prescription at the pharmacy and call the clinic to book a follow-up in 3 months
Bring a list of all medicines and supplements to the next visit.
Watch for vivid dreams or upset stomach, and call us if they last more than a week.
Discuss at next visit: driving safety; whether to start a support group.
The clinic is closed on Fridays.
